{{Quote|Our ''ship''...! Those mechanised ''arms'' seem to be... ''repairing'' it!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="TFF">{{StoryCite|story=The Final Fury!|book=Pizzazz 9}}</ref>}}
An '''unidentified starship''' was used as a scout ship by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] to make contact with the [[Akuria Rebel Base]]. It was destroyed in the [[Akuria system/Legends|Akuria system]] by robotic [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and forced to crash-land on [[Akuria II]].

==Description==
For the vital task of bringing the [[Akuria Rebel Base]] into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was given a silver scout craft piloted by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The ship was quite roomy for it size, with a wide-open compartment behind the two-seat cockpit uncluttered by equipment.<ref name="UPSWS1" /> The ship was maneuverable enough to dodge [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], and also equipped with a [[cosmic overdrive]] that could give it a short burst of tremendous speed.<ref name="untitled2">{{StoryCite|story=Untitled Pizzazz 2 comic|book=Pizzazz 2|sformatted=Untitled comic}}</ref> The ship was only lightly armed with a [[Laser turret/Legends|double laser turret]], and its hull was not particularly thick, but it was well-designed enough to leave its passengers unharmed after multiple crashes.<ref name="dread">{{StoryCite|story=Dread Discovery!|book=Pizzazz 3}}</ref><ref name="kingdom" />

==History==
Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] the Rebel Alliance became concerned that a scattered collection of Rebel movements would be vulnerable to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] sneak attack. They sent out the scout craft to [[Akuria II]], with the [[Mission to Akuria II|mission]] of contacting the independent [[Akuria Rebel Base]] and inviting them to join the Rebel Alliance. Leia Organa was chosen to lead this mission, with Luke Skywalker as her [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was brought on the mission in case communication with [[Droid/Legends|droids]] was required, while [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] contained the necessary [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] data to plot a course through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="UPSWS1" />

Unknown to any of them was that R2-D2's extensive damage during the Battle of Yavin had not been properly repaired. A malfunction caused the droid to send the scout craft wildly off course, to the [[Keeper's World system/Legends|Keeper's World system]], where they emerged in the middle of an Imperial fleet.<ref name="UPSWS1" /> While the ship's maneuverability and cosmic overdrive was enough to keep it from being vaporized, it suffered extensive damage and crashed on the [[Keeper's World]], initiating the [[Battle of The Keeper's World]].<ref name="untitled2" /> During that battle the Rebels befriended the godlike computer known as [[The Keeper]], who repaired their ship and allowed them to continue their mission to Akuria II.<ref name="TFF" />

The Imperial forces on Akuria II had set a trap for the Rebels, however, and once they arrived at their destination they were engaged by robotic [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] as part of an elaborate ruse. While Leia Organa was able to use the ship's turret to shoot down most of the fighters, the final fighter damaged the [[Engine/Legends|port engine]], and the scout craft crashed for the final time. It had served its purpose, however, of delivering the Rebels to their destination.<ref name="kingdom" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Three_engine_scout_ship.jpg|thumb|The scout craft, clearly showing three engines in ''The Final Fury!'']]
While the scout craft is undoubtedly the same one from the beginning of ''[[The Keeper's World]]'' story arc to its eventual destruction in ''[[The Kingdom of Ice!]]'', the appearance of the craft, and particularly the configuration and number of its engines, varied from issue to issue. In ''[[The Final Fury!]]'' it clearly has only three engines, but in ''[[The Kingdom of Ice!]]'' it appears to have three, four, or five depending on the panel.
